description: Proximity-seeking and protest met with deactivating moves. Strategies only; no style is ever assigned.
transcript:
A: Talk to me. Why don't you ever say something?
B: It's not a big deal. Can we talk about something else?
A: Do you even care? I have been asking all week.
B: I'll handle it myself. I don't need help.
A: Don't shut me out. Are we ok?
B: I'm fine.
A: If you really loved me you would answer me.
B: I'm used to doing it alone anyway.

gold.notes: gottman.stonewalling was removed from gold after review: B answers substantively every turn, which is deactivating, not listener withdrawal. It is listed under must_not_fire instead.
